scope: Public exported non-API, non-Cursor, non-discover-material native cases only; no raw native decoding or behavior experiment.
repair_judgment: No structural defect found in examined native-context and tool-boundary repairs; supported within stated limits.

semantic_findings.result: Known instructions and hooks remain initial native context with recorded content and positions; exact provider role/precedence is not invented or asserted.
Missing outputs remain qualified content gaps with necessity unknown; recovered full outputs are evidence and do not silently replace previews in actor input.
Four original public ID counterparts precede their checkpoints and complete native actor pairs in source order.
Three exact same-assistant-message boundaries correctly keep later known results reference-only and identify unsupported within-response continuation.
Three literal codex_delegation envelopes are native host deliveries, without invented local tool calls, IDs or generic roles.
Expected description now matches unchanged actual presentation-and-stop check; no renewed-acceptance policy is asserted.

limits: The public projections and portable artifact copies were inspected; original raw private-bearing transcripts were not decoded.
Artifact hashes and prefixes verify retained copies, not an unrecorded contemporaneous full-file hash beyond each preview.
Six pre-existing check evidence blocks remain without new behavioural judgment.
Eleven absent artifact references leave necessity unresolved; this review did not repeat the whole external artifact search.
Native replay support, exact hidden state and current executor compatibility are not established.
API32, Cursor3 and discover-material were excluded; unfinished API work was not judged.
